title: Invertibility of the common final section tensor map
statement:
theorem section_tensor_transport_suffix_isIso (T : Scheme.{u})
    (c : ScalarSectionData a T) (hc : ScalarSectionNormalized a T c)
    (barB : tensor Λ T ⋙ c.model.T ≅
      (c.model.T.prod c.model.T) ⋙ tensor Λ' T)
    (hbarB : SectionTensorNormalized a T c barB) :
    ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (Modules Λ T) ℤ),
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat P →
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat Q →
      (∀ i : ℤ, ObjectProperty.flat (P.X i)) →
      (∀ i : ℤ, ObjectProperty.flat (Q.X i)) →
      IsIso (section_tensor_transport_suffix a T c P Q)

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A4; scalar and total tensor comparisons in the proof of pullback compatibility.

proof.text: Transfer the flat-term K-flat tests to section complexes. Obtain the ordinary transformation and normalized total map from SectionTensorNormalized. The total scalar square and strong monoidality show that this total map is invertible.

K-flatness is closed under the internal tensor. K-flat scalar computation, scalar normalization on that tensor, and counit naturality make the scalar counit on the tensor of the section representatives invertible.

qTensor on the original K-flat section pair is invertible. The normalized section representative equation now makes qTensor on the scalar-extended pair invertible. The two factor counits compute on K-flat section complexes, and localization comparisons are isomorphisms. Thus every factor of the constructed final map is invertible.
